sentences.es: Matt llega al aeropuerto a las once de la noche.
sentences.en: Matt arrives at the airport at eleven at night.
sentences.natural: Matt llegal aeropuerto a lasonce de la noche.

sentences.es: Está cansado, pero tiene mucha hambre.
sentences.en: He's tired, but he's very hungry.

sentences.es: Toma un taxi y le dice al taxista: «Al centro, por favor».
sentences.en: He takes a taxi and tells the driver: 'Downtown, please.'
sentences.gist: He asks the taxi to take him downtown.

sentences.es: El taxista habla muy rápido y Matt dice: «¿Mande?».
sentences.en: The driver talks very fast and Matt says: 'Pardon?'
sentences.gist: He doesn't catch what the driver says.

sentences.es: Al final, los dos se ríen y Matt paga con tarjeta.
sentences.en: In the end, they both laugh and Matt pays by card.
